# Reading Tēzcatlīpōca through the work it rules today
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Tēzcatlīpōca**'s was unusually clear.

Tēzcatlīpōca's myths are all contest: with the earth-monster, with Quetzalcōātl, with the proud — he is the force that measures the strong by breaking them.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Tēzcatlīpōca
- **Pantheon:** Nahuatl
- **Domain of influence:** Night, Sorcery, Fate
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 236 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Foot in the Jaws.** To make the world, Tēzcatlīpōca and Quetzalcōātl descended to the primordial waters where the caiman-monster Cipactli floated, all mouths.  He offered his own foot as bait; the monster bit it off, and the two gods tore Cipactli apart — her body becoming the earth, her eyes the springs, her mouth the cave of creation. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Jaguar Sun.** Tēzcatlīpōca was the first sun, Nahui Ocēlōtl, "Four Jaguar": his world of giants ended when Quetzalcōātl struck him from the sky, and jaguars devoured the people.  Through the succession of suns the two brothers keep unmaking each other's worlds — the Aztec cosmos is their long quarrel, and the present fifth sun is only the latest armistice, held together by sacrifice. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Sorcery and fate are his canonical domain, and his obsidian smoking mirror served the Elizabethan magus John Dee as a working scrying glass — divination with a provenance.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Tēzcatlīpōca performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Optics, Imaging & Vision

*Cameras, lenses, biometrics, and imaging science. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*The obsidian smoking mirror; the first scrying lens of the Americas.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Cybersecurity & Digital Protection

*Threat defense, authentication, and digital trust. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The sorcerer who undid Tōllān by deception and tests kings disguised as a beggar; social engineering's most storied operator.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*The trickster-sovereign: the mirror that tests the hero, a ready-made boss mechanic.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Tēzcatlīpōca's myths are all contest: with the earth-monster, with Quetzalcōātl, with the proud — he is the force that measures the strong by breaking them. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in astrology, tarot & esoteric services, optics, imaging & vision, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/tezcatlipoca/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
